RC1.label: Credential & password issues

RC1.1.label: Forgotten password
RC1.1.description: User forgot their password and cannot sign in.

RC1.2.label: Reset email not received
RC1.2.description: Password reset email did not reach the user.

RC1.3.label: Incorrect credentials stored
RC1.3.description: Browser or password manager saved wrong credentials.

RC1.description: Root causes related to forgotten, expired, or incorrect user credentials and password recovery failures.

RC2.label: Institutional & entitlement issues

RC2.1.label: Institution not entitled
RC2.1.description: User institution does not have a subscription to the requested content.

RC2.2.label: Affiliation not recognised
RC2.2.description: System cannot match the user to their institution.

RC2.3.label: Entitlement configuration error
RC2.3.description: Entitlement exists but is misconfigured on the platform side.

RC2.description: Root causes where institutional configuration, entitlement, or SSO setup prevents access.

RC3.label: Security & network issues

RC3.1.label: IP address blocked
RC3.1.description: User IP address is blocked by Cloudflare or platform firewall.

RC3.2.label: Firewall or proxy interference
RC3.2.description: Corporate or institutional firewall blocking access.

RC3.3.label: Other security or network issue
RC3.3.description: Security or network issues not covered above.

RC3.description: Root causes involving network blocks, firewall rules, CDN interference, or IP restrictions.

RC4.label: System & platform issues

RC4.1.label: Link expired
RC4.1.description: A verification or reset link has passed its expiry time.

RC4.2.label: Account inactive
RC4.2.description: Account was deactivated due to inactivity or policy.

RC4.3.label: Platform bug or outage
RC4.3.description: Issue caused by a known or unknown platform defect.

RC4.description: Root causes related to software bugs, browser incompatibility, sync failures, or registration errors.

RC5.label: Other root cause

RC5.1.label: Other / Uncategorised
RC5.1.description: Root cause not covered by any specific category.

RC5.description: Root causes not fitting any category above.
